# Filsy — Desktop File Management & Search for Windows

> Filsy is a fast, private, local-first file manager and desktop search tool for Windows 10 (1809+) and Windows 11 (64-bit x64). It indexes local files across internal and external NTFS/exFAT drives with ~0.02s query latency, previews documents and media instantly using the Spacebar, extracts searchable text from screenshots with on-device OCR, and identifies duplicate files using SHA-256 cryptographic hashing.

## Key Capabilities & Technical Features

- **Sub-Second Local Search Engine**: Inverted index built directly on local disk. Queries return in ~0.02 seconds even across drives with 500,000+ files. Supports search by filename, directory, or plain natural queries.
- **Deep Content & Full-Text Search**: Extracts and queries text inside Microsoft Word (.docx), Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx), PDFs, source code (TypeScript, Python, C++, etc.), Markdown, and plain text.
- **Instant Spacebar Quick Look**: macOS Quick Look-style preview on Windows. Press Spacebar to inspect documents, 4K videos, high-fidelity audio, photos, and formatted code syntax highlighting without launching heavy external desktop applications.
- **On-Device Optical Character Recognition (OCR)**: Extracts and indexes text inside screenshots, photos, whiteboard captures, and scanned receipts using native on-device Windows OCR APIs. Zero cloud uploads and zero external computer vision APIs.
- **Exact Duplicate File Hunter**: Compares binary files using SHA-256 cryptographic hashes (not superficial filename matching). Allows safe comparison and sends duplicate files to the standard Windows Recycle Bin.
- **Storage Visualizer & Safe Cleanup**: Color-coded category storage bars and treemap visualizer identifying the 100 largest space hogs. Safe cleanup center purges %TEMP% and crash dumps with an automatic 24-hour safety buffer on recently modified files.
- **Windows Explorer Companion**: Designed to run alongside Windows File Explorer, not replace core shell functions. Provides 1-click "Open in Explorer", full path copying, and drag-and-drop into external applications.
- **100% Offline & Zero Telemetry**: All indexing, OCR, and hashing run exclusively on the local PC. Filsy requires zero user account creation and sends zero telemetry or file metadata to cloud servers.

## Operating System & System Requirements

- **Operating System**: Windows 10 (version 1809 or later), Windows 11 (64-bit x64 architecture).
- **Distribution Platform**: Official Microsoft Store (Product ID: 9N2ZWJ08B7X0) with automatic background updates.
- **Installation Footprint**: Approximately 70MB installer download.
- **Offline Capability**: Fully functional offline after initial one-time license check.

## Pricing & Licensing Model

- **Model**: One-time purchase, lifetime perpetual license. Zero recurring subscriptions.
- **Current Pre-Launch Price**: $9.00 USD (Early adopter special for the first 99 users celebrating Microsoft Store launch).
- **Regular Retail Price**: $19.00 USD.
- **Device Policy**: 1 license covers 1 active PC at a time. Users can move their license to a new PC anytime via in-app Settings or self-service license recovery.
- **Payment Processing**: Processed securely by Dodo Payments with instant digital license key delivery.
